**

Huber in Tirol

** **

Welcome to a world of tradition and innovation

** At **Huber in Tirol**, we invite you to experience the authentic charm of the Alps. Whether you're seeking adventure, relaxation, or culinary delights, our region offers something unforgettable. **

Innsbruck – The Heart of the Alps

** Discover **Innsbruck**, the vibrant capital of **Tirol**, where modern flair meets alpine tradition. Stroll through the picturesque **Altstadt**, visit the stunning **Goldenes Dachl**, or take a cable car up to the **Nordkette** for breathtaking views. **

Adventure Awaits

** From hiking in the **Zillertal Alps** to skiing in **St. Anton am Arlberg**, **Tirol** is a paradise for outdoor enthusiasts. Try your hand at white-water rafting on the **Inn River** or explore the dramatic landscapes of the **Ötztal**. **

Culinary Delights

** Indulge in **Tirol’s** famous dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Tiroler Gröstl**, or a hearty **Käsespätzle**. Our local breweries and wine cellars offer the perfect accompaniment—whether you prefer a crisp **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of **Veltliner**. **

Wellness & Relaxation

** Unwind in one of our luxurious **Alpenhotels** or wellness spas, where you can soak in thermal baths surrounded by the beauty of the mountains. Treat yourself to a massage or simply enjoy the tranquility of the **Tiroler countryside**. **

Culture & History

** Explore **Tirol’s** rich heritage at castles like **Burg Tratzberg** or **Schloss Ambras**, or visit the fascinating **Tiroler Volkskunstmuseum**. The region’s blend of history and modernity makes every visit unique. **

Plan Your Stay

** Whether you're here for a weekend getaway or a longer vacation, **Huber in Tirol** ensures an unforgettable experience. Discover the magic of the Alps—where every season offers new adventures. **

We look forward to welcoming you!

**
